reason: Albumen is an exact PO synonym of endosperm (PO_0009089); an albumenless seed is a seed without endosperm.
Alternipetal means placed between the petals, a position relative to another part (the petals), not a quality of the gland on its own.
A basidorsifixed anther is attached by its back near the base, so it fits the definition of dorsifixed; the 'near the base' detail is lost.

label: garlic-scented
definition: An odorous quality inhering in a plant structure by virtue of its having a pungent odour like that of garlic.
reason: A real diagnostic odour (e.g. Scorodophloeus, Afrostyrax) with no term; it fits the existing FLOPO odour series (sweet-scented, spicy-scented, foetid).

label: holoparasitic
definition: An organismal quality inhering in a plant by virtue of its obtaining all its water, nutrients and carbon from a host plant through haustoria, having little or no chlorophyll of its own. NOTE: FLOPO_0900045 whole plant parasitic is a phenotype class; a 'parasitic' value class above this one may be needed.
reason: A real trophic quality of whole plants with no PATO or FLOPO value term; the parent is uncertain because PATO has no parasitism quality.
Caducous organs are already mapped to PATO deciduous (generic); 'late' gives the timing, which is lost or belongs in the stage qualifier.
French 'modeste'/'médiocre' gives a vague impression of size with no scale; mapping it to medium-sized or small would be a guess.
Multijugate means a compound leaf with many pairs of leaflets, a count of leaflet pairs.
Negation of the existing FLOPO value petaloid.
A 'pod' is a fruit type, not a definite shape; 'pod-shaped follicles' gives no outline or cross-section that a shape term could hold.

target: new: quality of a part of the bearer (petal claw + broad PATO_0002359)
reason: The breadth belongs to the claw, a part of the petal, not to the petal; it pairs clawed (FLOPO:0991169) with broad on the claw, which has no PO class.

label: achlorophyllous
definition: A colour quality inhering in a plant or plant structure by virtue of its lacking chlorophyll, so that it is not green. NOTE: Not PATO:0002249 unpigmented; achlorophyllous plants are often brown, yellow or red.
reason: Chlorophyll is a chemical, not a PO part, so a presence or absence rule is not possible, and PATO has no matching term; a real quality of parasitic and mycoheterotrophic plants.
'Composed (of)' introduces the parts that make something up; it is not a quality, and 'fruit composé' is a fruit type that cannot be read without context.
States that prickles are present on the part; PO has prickle.
A compound of two values between elliptic (PATO_0000947, synonym ellipsoid) and spherical (PATO_0001499, synonym globular).
Says where the stipules sit relative to the petiole (PO_0020038), outside its base; with only 3 statements a relation is better than a new term.
A count of series stated as 'few'; the exact counts already have uniseriate, biseriate and multiseriate (FLOPO:0991090, 0991089, 0991084).
French 'plan-convexe' is plano-convex; 'flattened-convex' is a bad translation of it.
Adnate (FLOPO:0991129) towards the gynostemium (FLOPO_0986015), a relation to another part.
Intrusive parietal placentas project inwards into the ovary cavity; protruding covers this, and the cavity could be stated with PATO_0001645 protruding into.
French 'lianeux' means climbing like a liana, as the existing rule for lianescent.
A 'manifest' style or rib is clearly visible, the same reading as the rule for 'distinct'.
A prefix cut off from a word like 'multi- à pauciflores'; the full word is a count range and is handled by the count pattern.
A misspelling of French 'muriqué' = muricate; 'submuriquées' is the approximate value.
Says the inflorescence has few fascicles, a count of parts stated as 'few'.
Without stipules, the opposite of the existing 'stipulate' rule.

label: trilete
definition: A morphology quality inhering in a spore by virtue of its bearing on its proximal face a three-armed, Y-shaped scar (laesura) marking its contact with the other spores of the tetrad. NOTE: Sibling of monolete; PO has no laesura class for a presence rule.
reason: A standard diagnostic spore character (ferns, lycophytes) with no PATO or FLOPO term and no PO part to state as present.
